svg.text: Stage 6 — two databases, one model (2026-10-29)
Production moved to hosted PostgreSQL. Home machines and CI kept SQLite. ADR 019.
One data model
server/prisma/schema.prisma — the only place the
shape of the data is defined
SQLite — home & tests
Generated twin of the model, kept in sync
by a script; a test fails on drift
Local development · the test suite builds a
template database once and copies it per file
Unchanged workflow for the household install
PostgreSQL — production
Hosted on Supabase (EU region)
One squashed migration history
Applied automatically at container start
(prisma migrate deploy)
A model change needs a migration in each history
Why it went this way
The hosted demo needed a database that survives restarts on a free tier. Porting the tests to PostgreSQL was tried first and abandoned — 14 integration files
raced `db push` against one generated client. SQLite stayed for speed and isolation; Postgres became production-only. Same tables, same queries, no dialect-
specific SQL in application code.
Drawn from fe297ff · 4f007ef · f14dbd5 · 86104b7 · 68e0511 · 2010130 (2026-10-29, one day) · ADR 019 supersedes ADR 001
